desc:
Trapped in a mysterious, ever-changing environment, you and your team must race against time to solve intricate puzzles, crack cryptic riddles, and uncover hidden clues. Every corner holds a secret, every sound whispers a clue — but not everything is what it seems.
Will you outsmart the room before the clock runs out, or will you become part of its twisted story forever?

Join our official community server!
